name: Ales
source:
"Where's the hero? What? She's destroying the training camp again?"

The Hero [url=/c113642]Kiki[/url]'s victim... not exactly, but he still suffers!
He is a fine knight NPC belonging to the Order of the King's Guardians.
First of all, just dealing with Kiki is admirable. What's more, the previous hero supervisor was brought down by Kiki's unmanageability, and he is just taking over and serving in the supervisory role. He is nothing but a victim in all this.
He will also defend the capital. However, he must also take care of the hero.
It is a difficult job to be a captain. If a group of troublemakers led by [url=/c113636]Sensei[/url] stopped by, I wonder if ...... Ales' stomach would be able to withstand them!
If he can't endure, there will be trouble in the Royal Capital, so he must endure! Get your stomach pills ready while you still can! Those footsteps are surely approaching......!

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Human
Height: 182 cm
Occupation: Chivalric Order Commander
